Quick actions

Setup checklist

    Recent orders

    Zones show the cities people are heading to, what is special there, and which title covers it. Drag the handle to reorder.

    Store-wide reviews appear in the "What readers say" section. Per-title reviews are edited inside each title.

    Images

    Covers, sample pages, zone photos, and the author photo. Public. Up to 12 MB each.

    Product files

    The guides and books buyers download. Private: served only through signed links after payment. Up to 95 MB each.

    By title

    Orders

    Readers who asked to be told when a place is covered. Tell them with Announce once the title is live, then clear the request.

    Email every buyer of a title

    Use this when you revise a guide. It goes to everyone who bought that title through Stripe.

    Store

    Social links

    About the author

    Photo

    Regions by country

    Full lists of states or provinces, one per line, so the atlas can show "Coming soon" entries. Countries with published titles appear automatically; add the rest here.

    Import and export

    The catalog is a single JSON file. Export it to keep a copy or to commit as dist/guides.json; import one to replace everything here.

    Backups

    A backup is kept every time you publish. Restore one, then publish again to make it live.

    Local draft

    Unpublished edits are kept in this browser. Discard them to return to the last published catalog.
